channel.title: DAC&FW Seasonal Crop Advisories - Madhya Pradesh

item.title: Soybean: Harvesting and Storage Management
item.description: Harvest soybean crops when 90% of pods turn golden brown to avoid pod shattering losses. Check for tobacco caterpillar in late maturing fields and dry grains to below 12% moisture before bagging.

item.title: Gram (Chickpea): Seed Treatment and Pre-Sowing Irrigation
item.description: Give pre-sowing light irrigation (Palewa). Treat seed with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg seed followed by Rhizobium culture to safeguard against wilt and root rot diseases.
